text: Figure 4.56: Modeling of DiagnosticEvent [TPS_DEXT_03011] Clearing request for a DiagnosticEvent Upstream requirements: RS_DEXT_00023 ⌈Furthermore, a clearing request for a DiagnosticEvent might require invocation of a callback to a SWC in order to allow or to prohibit the clearing operation. The expectation on this callback interface can be expressed using the attribute event- ClearAllowed: • always indicates that a clearing request for the DiagnosticEvent shall un- conditionally be executed . • In case of requiresCallbackExecution, the execution of a callback shall decide whether the clearing is permitted . In other words, the implementation of this decision is up to the developer of the corresponding AtomicSwComponentType. emplate
